name: Enforceable deferred producer/ATL compensation
ireland_finding: Ireland: payment no later than four months after completion; other programs remain program-specific.
safe_treatment: Do not recognize until paid and evidenced; keep payable visible.

name: Compensation paid by statutory deadline using production or loan proceeds
transaction_definition: Real payment is made by the deadline from cash or loan proceeds.
ireland_finding: Source of cash does not erase the loan; service, eligibility, payment, and documentation still control.
safe_treatment: Recognize only eligible actual payment; retain debt as liability.

name: Compensation paid, then separately reinvested as equity
transaction_definition: Payment and later equity subscription/contribution are legally separate cash flows.
ireland_finding: Ireland authority confirms fee rules but not the complete paid-then-reinvested chain.
safe_treatment: Never count equity inflow as QPE or recursive support; seek written ruling.

name: Producer receivable contributed or capitalized as equity
transaction_definition: Unpaid receivable is converted into equity without cash payment.
ireland_finding: Ireland requires deferred fees to be paid by deadline; no authority located treating receivable contribution as payment.
safe_treatment: Do not treat capitalization as payment or QPE without ruling.

name: Related-party producer fee or overhead at arm’s-length/FMV
transaction_definition: Related producer supplies real services for a substantiated fee.
ireland_finding: Ireland expressly requires typical services, wholly/exclusively/necessarily performed, with arm’s-length pricing and related-party substantiation.
safe_treatment: Require contracts, invoices, service evidence, cost support, market support, ledger and payment evidence.

name: In-kind goods or services recognized at FMV
transaction_definition: Non-cash goods/services are booked at asserted FMV.
ireland_finding: No general Ireland Section 481 permission for donated/in-kind FMV was located; actual-incurred-cost language cuts against nominal value.
safe_treatment: Zero incremental QPE absent express program authority and valuation rule.

name: Vendor credit, discount, rebate, forgiveness, contra, or netting
transaction_definition: A claimed cost is reduced or extinguished by a credit or related entry.
ireland_finding: Ireland requires credit notes/bank evidence, disallows unincurred/inflated recharges, and requires revised claims after material expenditure reduction.
safe_treatment: Use actual net cost; reverse QPE/incentive when obligation is reduced.

name: Contingent/backend compensation
transaction_definition: Compensation depends on receipts, earnings, profits, or backend participation.
ireland_finding: Ireland expressly excludes these amounts from qualifying expenditure.
safe_treatment: Exclude from Ireland QPE; other programs require their own authority.

name: Loan-funded payment with producer retaining repayment liability
transaction_definition: Producer fee is genuinely paid using borrowed cash and debt remains outstanding.
ireland_finding: Ireland rule turns on real services/payment; no authority located converting the debt into support or eliminating repayment.
safe_treatment: Recognize only qualifying paid fee; preserve principal, interest and repayment in economics.

name: Capitalized or accrued service cost
transaction_definition: Service cost is accrued/capitalized but not paid.
ireland_finding: Ireland deferred fees must be paid within four months after completion.
safe_treatment: Keep as payable; no QPE until authority-specific payment condition is met.

name: Circular or temporary payment lacking substantive economic separation
transaction_definition: Cash is temporarily cycled solely to create evidence of payment/headroom.
ireland_finding: Actual-cost, wholly/exclusively/necessarily, related-party substantiation, credit-note and bank-record requirements apply; no complete supporting authority located.
safe_treatment: No positive gross-up; flag for substance review and written ruling.
